headline: My Pipes Burst After Hours – What Should I Do?
articleBody: Discovering a burst pipe after normal business hours can be really stressful, but staying calm and acting fast can minimize the damage to your Las Vegas home or business. The most important thing is to stop the water flow as quickly as possible to prevent further issues. First, identify the specific fixture or pipe that's affected and try to close its local shutoff valve if it's safe to do so. If the water keeps coming or you can't find a local valve, head straight for your main water shutoff. This is usually near your water meter or where the main line enters your property. Next, make sure to stay away from any wet electrical equipment to avoid hazards. You'll want to contain the water as best you can with buckets or towels and start documenting the damage with photos or videos. This helps your plumber and can be useful for insurance later. When you call CG Plumbing Solutions, be ready to tell them where the leak is, if you've managed to shut off the water, and if there are any electrical or sewage hazards. We're here 24/7 for these kinds of emergencies across the Las Vegas Valley.
